answer.summary: The one failing test, libUtilityClasses 'every class written in a className exists in that stylesheet', reports four classes used in the changed GraphExplorer.tsx (flex-grow, outline-2, left-3, top-3) that resolve to nothing at runtime. The change introduced them, so a rerun will fail the same way. The MissingTranslationError lines are log noise and do not fail the job.
